chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked: “Which charity is best?” He said:
“The effort of one who has little. Have you not heard the word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
‘And they give preference over themselves, even though they are in need.’
Do you see any surplus here?”

key_terms.اَلصَّدَقَةِ: charity given for the sake of Allah
key_terms.جُهْدُ: the utmost effort or what one bears with difficulty

ai.seo_question: Which kind of charity is considered the best in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the best charity is what is given by someone who has little, because it reflects sincerity, sacrifice, and preference for others over oneself. The Imam عليه السلام supports this meaning with the Qur’anic praise of those who give despite their own need, showing the high ethical rank of selfless generosity.
